themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform research tasks, interact with systems, and make decisions autonomously within research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and refactoring code, often suggesting code snippets or identifying errors.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing a variety of AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid researchers in data analysis, discovery, and insight generation.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the use, impact, and limitations of AI chatbots in research contexts, including user interaction and data gathering.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is applied to the field of UX and product design, from ideation to interface generation and user experience enhancement.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text, such as research papers, articles, or meeting transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Investigates the effects of AI on jobs, employment, skills, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles related to the creation and use of artificial or simulated users for testing, research, or generating content.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in automating software testing processes, including test case generation, execution, and analysis.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI tools are used to support or enhance qualitative research methods, such as analyzing open-ended responses or interview data.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
